description: Delete the caller's own forum post, or, with `community`, a post imported into that community (owner or PDS admin).

community.description: Delete a post imported into this community (net.openfederation.forum.importBatch) instead of one of the caller's own. Owner or PDS admin only. The post stays deleted when the import is run again.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No post of yours with that rkey, or no imported post with that rkey in the community.

errors.name: CommunitySuspended
errors.description: The community has been suspended by the PDS administrator and accepts no writes.

errors.name: CommunityTakenDown
errors.description: The community has been taken down.

errors.name: CommunityMoved
errors.description: The community has moved to another PDS; this copy is read-only (#267).

errors.name: CommunityImporting
errors.description: The community is still arriving here and is not active yet (#267).

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: With `community`: the caller is not the community's owner or a PDS admin.

errors.name: NotMember
errors.description: With `community`: the caller is not a member of the community.
